200:t_1:3.en: ～ $$ラース・バビロン$$ Imperial Palace ～

200:t_1:7.en:
$$執務官$$
「Earthlings, you may raise your heads.」

200:t_1:8.en:
$$執務官$$
「From this moment, you are permitted an audience with His Majesty $$アウストラリス$$, Emperor of the $$新地球皇国$$.」

200:t_1:10.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Your Majesty $$アウストラリス$$... I am $$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$, Vice Foreign Minister of the $$地球連邦$$.」

200:t_1:12.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Now that we have come this far, I will not ask how we got here. I intend to make the fullest use of this chance to speak with you.」

200:t_1:13.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Please tell me the purpose of your invasion of Earth. If it is emigration or an energy problem, the $$連邦政府$$ intends to hold talks.」

200:t_1:15.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「What exactly did you come to this Earth for?」

200:t_1:16.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Is your goal to extract the Earth's $$次元力$$ through the $$レイライン$$s you have spread across every region?」

200:t_1:21.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「That is all. Take them away.」

200:t_1:22.en:
$$リリーナ$$
「Please wait! We are not finished talking!」

200:t_1:24.en:
$$ナナリー$$
「Do you think such lawlessness will be tolerated forever!?」

200:t_1:25.en:
$$執務官$$
「Know your place, Earthling. You stand before His Majesty!」

200:t_1:26.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「Those people will be of use. Treat them with courtesy.」

200:t_1:27.en:
$$執務官$$
「Yes, Your Majesty... As you command.」

200:t_1:29.en:
$$執務官$$
「Now come. You will be given a new role.」

200:t_1:30.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「...Those who were said to bear this planet's future... They are strong.」

200:t_1:31.en:
$$アウストラリス$$
「But nothing can be protected with words...」

200:t_1:38.en:
$n
「Major $$カリーニン$$, you were on the advance scouting mission too. Good work out there.」

200:t_1:39.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「...This used to be a beautiful city, though...」

200:t_1:41.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I was, on a mission.」

200:t_1:42.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「$l... What do you think of the world as it is now?」

200:t_1:44.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Don't you think it's wrong?」

200:t_1:45.en:
$n
「A world where innocent people's lives are taken... I can't believe something like that is right.」

200:t_1:46.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「Then what is to be done?」

200:t_1:47.en:
$n
「We should overthrow the Empire as quickly as possible and...」

200:t_1:48.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「...That would not solve the problem at its root.」

200:t_1:52.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「I have a report to make about $$ラース・バビロン$$. I'll return ahead of you.」

200:t_1:53.en:
$$カリーニン$$
「$l... I'm leaving $$相良$$ in your care.」

200:t_1:55.en:
$$スズネ$$
「...That was Major $$カリーニン$$ just now, wasn't it?」

200:t_1:57.en:
$$スズネ$$
「He looked grim, but what were you two talking about?」

200:t_1:59.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The battle to take $$ラース・バビロン$$, right...? If we can just pull that off...」

200:t_1:62.en:
$n
(Those guys... aren't like the enemies we've faced until now... To beat them...)

200:t_1:67.en: ～ $$マクロス・クォーター$$ Briefing Room ～

200:t_1:68.en:
$$エイミー$$
「...So $$Ｆｉｒｅ　Ｂｏｍｂｅｒ$$ traveled all over the world singing, huh.」

200:t_1:69.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「Given the situation, it wasn't exactly all that carefree.」

200:t_1:70.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「The truth is, we were chased by the $$サイデリアル$$ the whole time, and we sang while running away, more or less.」

200:t_1:71.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「Well... So what we were doing was no different from back when we were with $c. In short, it's business as usual.」

200:t_1:72.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「$$バサラ$$ gets carried away because our band master, $$レイ#pt231$$, acts like that!」

200:t_1:73.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Um... $$ミレーヌ$$... $$バサラ$$ himself isn't listening...」

200:t_1:75.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「What's with that!? Are you imitating $$キリコ$$!? Or are you asleep!?」

200:t_1:76.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Shut up... I'm concentrating for the next live show.」

200:t_1:77.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「The next live show... That means the battle to take $$ラース・バビロン$$, doesn't it?」

200:t_1:78.en:
$$バサラ$$
「You bet. I'll make it the biggest, best stage ever.」

200:t_1:79.en:
$$エイミー$$
「Amazing, $$レド$$! $$バサラ$$ really will sing anywhere!」

200:t_1:82.en:
$$レド$$
「I don't understand him at all...」

200:t_1:83.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「This unit likewise cannot provide a logical explanation for his actions.」

200:t_1:84.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Ensign $$レド$$... I have heard about you from Major $$オズマ$$.」

200:t_1:85.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「I've also heard that most of your life has been spent in battle, and that you never had a chance to experience culture.」

200:t_1:87.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「A term denoting the whole of humanity's productive activity. Within the $$人類銀河同盟$$, it is seen only in limited settings.」

200:t_1:88.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「With a background like that, what did you think when you heard $$バサラ$$'s song?」
